description: This file contains LESS mixins defining grid system components for Bootstrap, including column sizing, offsets, pushes, pulls, and container styles for responsive layouts.

methods.name: .container-fixed
methods.description: Creates a centered container with optional gutter spacing and clearfix extension.

methods.name: .make-row
methods.description: Creates a row wrapper that clears floats and handles gutter spacing.

methods.name: .make-xs-column
methods.description: Defines extra small column styles with width based on column count and gutter, float, and padding.

methods.name: .make-xs-column-offset
methods.description: Offsets extra small columns by a specified number of columns.

methods.name: .make-xs-column-push
methods.description: Pushes extra small columns to the right.

methods.name: .make-xs-column-pull
methods.description: Pulls extra small columns to the left.

methods.name: .make-sm-column
methods.description: Defines small screen columns with media query for min-width @screen-sm-min.

methods.name: .make-md-column
methods.description: Defines medium screen columns with media query for min-width @screen-md-min.

methods.name: .make-lg-column
methods.description: Defines large screen columns with media query for min-width @screen-lg-min.
